# Screenbridge

> Screenbridge Inc. is a New York video agency. We make UGC-style TV ads from the social content brands already have, and we run them on connected TV through Reach. We work with direct-to-consumer brands, local businesses and the agencies that serve them, in the United States. Contact: info@screenbridge.tv.

Screenbridge is powered by Filmkraft.tv, the creative video agency behind the ads.

## Ways to work with us

- [Ads](https://www.screenbridge.tv/creative): Standard, Premium and Signature CTV ads built from existing social ads or creator footage, delivered in 10, 15 or 20 business days. Two ways to pay: upfront per ad, or the Performance Plan, billed as a share of the media spend the ads run on.
- [Reach](https://www.screenbridge.tv/reach): CTV campaigns we plan and run, with the ads included. Full detail at https://reach.screenbridge.tv.
